en: A vintage sepia-toned postcard view taken from a hillside café terrace under large trees, overlooking a city with low buildings and several mosque minarets. In the foreground people sit at tables of a Turkish café, with bottles and glasses visible. The scene looks out across fortifications or ramparts toward the city and plain below. Printed captions in French and English appear along the bottom, and a website watermark appears across the lower right.
